**<sub><sub>![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Guard direct image pipeline exceptions**

When the injected image seam throws instead of returning a `Result`—for example the live adapter can still throw on a malformed 200 provider payload where `payload.data` is a non-array at `src/lib/adapters/image-generation-seam/index.ts:103`—this direct `await` now lets the exception escape `/api/generate`, producing SvelteKit's generic 500 response rather than the generate contract. Before this change the internal `/api/image-generation` fetch converted a crashing image route into a `Response`, and the surrounding JSON parse/status handling returned a contract-shaped `IMAGE_HTTP_ERROR`, so this removes that fallback for the main generate endpoint.

Useful? React with 👍 / 👎.
